output.reason: The regulation amends PMK 9/PMK.03/2021 and extends the government-borne PPh 21 (PPh Pasal 21 ditanggung Pemerintah) facility for employees from the period January-June 2021 to Masa Pajak December 2021. It also narrows the extension to employers whose business classification code (KLU) is listed in the Lampiran for the PPh 21 DTP incentive. This changes a facility and its validity period, which in turn changes the PPh 21 borne by permanent employees. Other provisions (PPh final, PPh 22 Impor, PPh 25 installments, VAT refunds, notification and realization reporting procedures) are administrative or concern other taxes.
